newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian base metals steady on improved trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian base metals steady on improved trade.

text.p: Indian base metals on Monday held steady at improved levels, dealers said.
Industrial consumer demand however remained low on Monday but limited arrivals kept market in a narrow price band, they said. Ready copper was steady at 12,450 rupees.
Traders said they expected state-owned Hindustan Copper to raise prices after private producer Sterlite Industries hiked its sale price of copper by 5,000 rupees per tonne last week.
Tin was quiet at 34,700 rupees and nickel at 36,800 rupees.
Zinc was steady at 6,425 rupees, lead at 4,600 rupees and aluminium at 7,300 rupees.
